namespace = cwp_africa

# Cold War Project: decolonization in Africa (generated by gen_africa2.py; edit freely)
# 1-4 Gold Coast, 10-14 Kenya, 20-24 Belgian Congo and Katanga, 30-32 Portuguese Africa

cwp_africa.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_africa.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.1.d_gbr
				trigger = { c:GBR ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.1.d_glc
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.1.f_gbr
				trigger = { c:GBR ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.1.f_glc
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_leader_arguing"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.1.b_gbr
		trigger = { c:GBR ?= ROOT }
		c:GLC ?= { add_liberty_desire = -5 }
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.1.c_gbr
		trigger = { c:GBR ?= ROOT }
		c:GLC ?= { add_liberty_desire = 5 }
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.1.b_other
		trigger = { NOT = { c:GBR ?= ROOT } }
		add_liberty_desire = 5
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
}

cwp_africa.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_africa.4.t
	desc = cwp_africa.4.d
	flavor = cwp_africa.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_public_protest"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_gold_election_won } }
			set_global_variable = cwp_gold_election_won
			remove_global_variable = cwp_gold_campaign_running
			c:GLC ?= { add_liberty_desire = 10 }
			c:GBR ?= { trigger_event = { id = cwp_africa.4 popup = yes } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.4.b_gbr
		trigger = { c:GBR ?= ROOT }
		c:GLC ?= { add_liberty_desire = 5 }
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

				trigger = { c:BEL ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.22.d_cng
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.22.f_bel
				trigger = { c:BEL ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.22.f_cng
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_soldiers_breaking_protest"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.22.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.22.b_other
		trigger = { NOT = { c:BEL ?= ROOT } }
		add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_rally_effect years = 2 }
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.22.c_other
		trigger = { NOT = { c:BEL ?= ROOT } }
		add_treasury = cwp_choice_cost
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.22.b_bel
		trigger = { c:BEL ?= ROOT }
		if = { limit = { exists = c:CNG NOT = { c:CNG = ROOT } } change_relations = { country = c:CNG value = -20 } }
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
